$comment: Number formats (GAME_DESIGN 18.3, E.12; decision 64): the tokens web/js/fmt.js words a number with its unit by, each approved once, so a height or a mile reads the same on every phone and never in its locale. fmt.js fills the number (ASCII digits, a comma every three, a point before tenths); web/js/text.js shows a format's spaces as no-break spaces, so the number never breaks from its unit. S5 has two, both the trail frame's; times, dates and am/pm join with their sessions. Drafts until B004 is answered; preview only.

fmt.ft.ctx: A height in feet: the trail caption's elevation, 4,900 ft (12.2). Never broken across a row

fmt.mile_marker.ctx: The strip's mile marker: how far along today's route you are, mi 6.9 (12.2). Never broken across a row
